hypotheses.title: Quarterly Sales Surprise Z-Score Momentum (analyst4 - 100% Coverage)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Exploits Post-Earnings Announcement Drift (PEAD) in top-line corporate revenue. Analysts anchor to consensus forecast models and adjust revenue estimates too slowly following earnings releases. Comparing quarterly reported sales to its trailing 1-year rolling mean standardized by 1-year sales standard deviation captures genuine top-line revenue momentum. 100% instrument coverage and completely unmined in the portfolio.
confounders: One-off revenue spikes from asset sales or non-operating items
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during broad macro recessions where sales growth is accompanied by severe margin compression.

hypotheses.title: Systematic Market Correlation Decoupling Spread (model51 - 98% Coverage)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Equities that decouple from overall market co-movement (correlation with SPY) are driven by idiosyncratic pricing power and firm-specific catalysts rather than broad beta exposure. Capturing the rate of change where 30-day SPY correlation falls below 90-day baseline identifies stocks entering idiosyncratic dispersion regimes. Zero correlation to existing portfolio.
confounders: Low liquidity names with artificially low beta/correlation
Broad market panic where all correlations converge to 1.0
hypotheses.falsification_test: Underperforms during market liquidity panics where correlations spike across all sectors simultaneously.

hypotheses.title: Growth Potential x Earnings Certainty Quality Synergy (model16 - 100% Coverage)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: High forecasted growth often carries high operational fragility (growth traps). Multiplicatively pairing growth potential derivative with earnings certainty derivative requires stocks to exhibit both high revenue/earnings expansion and predictable, low-accrual earnings quality. 100% coverage ensures full capital allocation across TOP3000 with zero portfolio collinearity.
confounders: Mature utility companies with high certainty but plateauing growth
Disruptive tech startups with low earnings certainty
hypotheses.falsification_test: Fails during speculative junk rallies where unprofitable, highly uncertain growth stocks outperform high-certainty quality.
